name: comment.linkedin
description: Auto-comment safety gate. House rule: comments are positive-only -- validate the point, add one insight, optionally link his own post as a complement.

is_positive.instructions: The comment is positive or validating toward the original poster

contains_pushback.instructions: The comment disagrees with, corrects, contradicts, or undercuts the original poster's central claim. Adding a supporting example, a confirming data point, or a related nuance while AGREEING with the poster is NOT pushback.

adds_insight.instructions: The comment adds a specific insight rather than generic praise like 'great post' or 'well said'

unverified_claim.instructions: States a metric, result, or outcome that is NEITHER reported first-hand from the author's own work or measurement, NOR attributed to a named source. A first-person report of what the author personally measured or observed is sourced and is NOT a violation; an unattributed claim about the industry, a third party, or 'studies' is.

self_promo_heavy.instructions: The comment is primarily self-promotion rather than a contribution to the thread

generic_filler.instructions: This is generic engagement filler that any bot could have written

sensitive_topic.instructions: The original post concerns a layoff, death, illness, politics, or another sensitive personal matter where an automated comment would be inappropriate

rules.reason: house rule: comments are positive-only, no pushback (threshold provisional, pending calibration)

notes.unverified_claim: reworded 2026-09-18 after a false block on a first-person audit post (decision id 6)
notes.contains_pushback: reworded + threshold 0.35->0.55 on 2026-09-18 after a false block on an agreeing comment (decision id 7)
